description: This file contains implementation of big number context management functions for OpenSSL's BIGNUM library, including stack management, context creation, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: BN_CTX_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new BN_CTX structure.

methods.name: BN_CTX_free
methods.description: Frees a BN_CTX structure and associated resources.

methods.name: BN_CTX_start
methods.description: Begins a new temporary variable scope in BN_CTX.

methods.name: BN_CTX_get
methods.description: Retrieves a temporary BIGNUM from the context, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: BN_CTX_end
methods.description: Ends a temporary variable scope in BN_CTX, restoring previous state.
